flagged.title: Chapters 1-3: The Rebellion
flagged.reason: The video states that Napoleon and Snowball took charge and drove Mr Jones off the farm, which contradicts the spontaneous nature of the Rebellion and would lose marks in an exam.

mark_affecting.quote: After Old Major dies, the pigs, specifically Napoleon and Snowball, step up to take charge and they actually manage to drive Mr. Jones off the farm.

flagged.title: Chapters 7-8: Terror & Purges
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that 'Beasts of England' was replaced by a new song praising Napoleon himself, conflating Minimus's Chapter 7 anthem praising the farm with the separate Chapter 8 poem 'Comrade Napoleon'.

mark_affecting.quote: And what actually replaces Beasts of England? A new song entirely praising Napoleon himself.
